# bintables/deref

> Dereference: load 1 or 8 bytes from the address in rax.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/deref.pkg) · translates [std/deref](../std/deref.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when self size 1`

```nasm
{p}
movzx eax, byte [rax]
```

### `emit`

```nasm
{p}
mov rax, [rax]
```

### `emit addr`

```nasm
{p}
```
